nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

**Key inputs**

- **prompt**: describe the shots, camera moves, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

## Model Links

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) (19.53 GB)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) (14.61 GB)

**loras**

- 8 steps:  [minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/resolve/main/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) (1.82 GB)
-  4 steps: [minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) (1.82 GB)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is the zombie woman from <Video 1>. Use this reference exclusively for her identity, facial features, hairstyle, zombie appearance, skin texture, body proportions and overall physical appearance.

Her clothing and wardrobe are defined exclusively by <Video 2>. Reproduce the exact dress, colours, fabric, cut, shape, tears, holes, stains, wear and every visible clothing detail from <Video 2>.

summary:

[reference generation] Create a six-second cinematic horror sequence featuring <Subject 1> wearing the exact outfit shown in <Video 2>, performing dynamic physical movements on a deserted street at night, finishing with a playful finger-gun gesture and spoken dialogue.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - Maintain the exact identity and physical appearance from <Video 1>.

Wardrobe: fully_preserved - Maintain the exact clothing design and appearance from <Video 2>. No substitutions, redesigns or recolouring.

The two references have separate roles. <Video 1> determines identity. <Video 2> determines clothing.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1] A single continuous cinematic shot on a deserted urban street at night.

0–1.5 seconds: <Subject 1> walks towards the camera with an uneven, hunched zombie gait, her arms swinging loosely.

1.5–2.5 seconds: She suddenly pivots, spins around and launches herself sideways into a complete barrel roll.

2.5–4.2 seconds: She completes the 360-degree barrel roll across the wet asphalt, plants her hands and feet and pushes herself upright.

4.2–6 seconds: Now standing and facing the camera, she suddenly raises both hands, forms playful finger guns using her index fingers and thumbs, points them directly towards the camera and cheekily says, "Bang bang!" Her delivery is deadpan and unexpectedly playful, contrasting with her frightening zombie appearance.

The dialogue must be clearly audible, synchronised with her mouth movements and spoken naturally within the available time. She finishes holding the finger-gun pose.

ENVIRONMENT:
A completely new deserted urban street at night. Wet reflective asphalt, dark buildings, abandoned cars and drifting ground fog.

LIGHTING AND COLOUR:
Cold blue-toned nighttime lighting throughout the scene. Deep midnight-blue shadows, cool cyan-blue ambient illumination and subtle steel-blue highlights reflecting across the wet asphalt. Streetlights emit a dim, cold blue-white light rather than warm yellow or amber. Maintain a dark, eerie, desaturated cinematic horror colour palette. No orange lighting, no yellow streetlights, no warm golden tones. The overall image should have a distinctly cool blue tint.

CHARACTER AND WARDROBE CONTINUITY:
Preserve the identity from <Video 1> and the exact wardrobe from <Video 2> throughout the entire sequence. The dress must retain its original design, colour, material, construction and distinctive damage. Only natural fabric movement and folding are permitted.

CAMERA:
Slightly low camera angle, wide full-body framing, smooth tracking to keep the character visible. One uninterrupted shot with no cuts or transitions.

overall_soundscape:

Nighttime urban ambience, footsteps on wet asphalt, fabric movement, realistic ground-contact sounds during the barrel roll, followed by her clearly audible spoken words.

non_diegetic_music:

N/A

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
